test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation focusing on the underlined words.

I invited them to my anniversary dinner but they had other plans, so they decided__ to politely decline with the implication that they may come at a later date__.

options.text: Took it with a grain of salt

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"politely decline with the implication that they may come at a later date"** means to refuse an invitation or offer, but suggest that the acceptance might occur in the future. (भविष्य में स्वीकार करने का सुझाव देते हुए विनम्रतापूर्वक अस्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She had to **take a rain check **on the dinner invitation due to a prior commitment, but promised to attend the next gathering.
 
 
 
• **"To take a rain check"** is an idiom used when you decline an invitation or offer but indicate that you might accept it at a later time. (सुझाव देना कि आप बाद में स्वीकार करेंगे)
 
 
• **Example: **I'd love to go to the movies tonight, but I have to work. Can I take a rain check?
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate idiom for **'politely decline with the implication that they may come at a later date'** is **'To take a rain check'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To spoil a moment **(क्षण को खराब करना): To ruin or diminish the enjoyment or importance of a particular moment.

 
 
• **Example:** Telling him the bad news on his birthday really **spoiled the moment.**
 
 
 
• **Call it a day **(दिन समाप्त करना): To stop working for the day; to end a task.
 
 
• **Example: **We’ve been working hard for hours; let’s **call it a day.**
 
 
 
• **Took it with a grain of salt** (संदेह करना): To take something lightly or view it with skepticism.
 
 
• **Example:** He** took her story with a grain of salt** because it seemed exaggerated.
 
 

382:Tddc,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
